name: wasat-shop

scripts.deploy: bun run lint && bun run test:rules && bun run test:functions && bun run build && bun run build:share && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore
scripts.test:rules: bun scripts/client-order-sample.ts && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-manstyle 'node --test tests/firestore.rules.test.mjs tests/audit-attacks.test.mjs'
scripts.test:functions: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-manstyle 'cd functions && bun test test/'
scripts.test:e2e: VITE_USE_EMULATORS=true vite build --outDir dist-e2e --emptyOutDir && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project ai-studio-applet-webapp-e9574 'playwright test'
scripts.measure:visit: VITE_USE_EMULATORS=true vite build --outDir dist-e2e --emptyOutDir && JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="$JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS -Xmx4g" firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project ai-studio-applet-webapp-e9574 'bun tests/visit/seed.ts && playwright test -c playwright.visit.config.ts && bun --preload ./tests/visit/share-preload.ts scripts/share-pages.ts --fingerprint > /dev/null'
scripts.measure:speed: VITE_USE_EMULATORS=true vite build --outDir dist-e2e --emptyOutDir && JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="$JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS -Xmx4g" firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project ai-studio-applet-webapp-e9574 'bun tests/visit/seed.ts && playwright test -c playwright.speed.config.ts'
scripts.measure:admin: VITE_USE_EMULATORS=true vite build --outDir dist-e2e --emptyOutDir && JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="$JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS -Xmx4g" firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project ai-studio-applet-webapp-e9574 'VISIT_ORDERS=1 bun tests/visit/seed.ts && VISIT_ORDERS=1 playwright test -c playwright.visit.config.ts tests/visit/admin.spec.ts'

description: Wasat Shop — интернет-магазин мужской одежды (React + Vite + Firebase)
